title: [Main]-Test disabled after BCApps uptake: Reminder Automation Tests.TestReminderAutomationLogsInteractionWithIssuedReminderNumber fails (CZ)
summary: A one-line fix in the Czech Reminder CZL report resolves the failure of the reminder automation test that logs interactions with the issued reminder number in CZ, so the disabled test can be enabled again.
key_points: One-line change in the Reminder CZL report (report 31182)
The test had been disabled after the BCApps uptake
Affects reminder automation in the Czech localization
quote: Enable disabled TestReminderAutomationLogsInteractionWithIssuedReminderNumber fails which is failing in CZ
